title: Entitled Woman Punches Cop in The Face
description:
On January 15th, 2022, officers were dispatched in reference to a woman violating a PFA. As soon as they arrived on the scene, they recognized the suspect from their previous encounters and knew that she could become very uncooperative. Here's what happened next. The female kept screaming and shouting at the officers even after getting arrested, which was only going to work against her. The female was charged with Battery, Violation of District Court Order and Resisting Arrest.
